expr: (() => { const s=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select'); const S=window.simState; return s[0].value==='1' && s[1].value==='1' && document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]').value==='0' && S.tapaus==='1' && S.t===0 && S.xA===0 && S.x2===0 && S.running===false ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: case 1, speed normaali, t = 0, both carts at x = 0, not running (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const r=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return r.min==='0' && r.max==='10' && r.step==='0.5' && document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]').length===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one slider, the clock t: 0-10 s in steps of 0,5 s

expr: (() => { const o=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')[0].options].map(x=>x.value+':'+x.textContent).join('|'); return o==='1:1: sama lähtöpaikka|2:2: eri lähtöpaikka|3:3: vastakkaiset suunnat|4:4: edestakainen liike' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: case select: four cases
speed select hidas 0.5, normaali 1, nopea 2

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button Käynnistä first, then Alusta; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const l=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root label')].map(x=>x.textContent); return l.length===3 && l[0].startsWith('Tapaus') && /^Hetki t = .* s$/.test(l[1]) && l[2].startsWith('Nopeus (toisto)') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: three labelled controls: Tapaus, Hetki t with unit s, Nopeus (toisto)

expr: (() => { const d=document.querySelector('#sim-root details'); return d && d.querySelector('summary').textContent==='Lisätietoja' && !d.open && /mallin arvoja/.test(d.textContent) && /vakionopeudella/.test(d.textContent) ? 1 : 0 })()
note: explanations behind a closed Lisätietoja: model values, constant velocity

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='t,tapaus' && P.t.unit==='s' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares t (s) and tapaus

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); return c.width===600 && c.height===400 ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas is 600x400
